records.quote: Proposition 4. Let X1 having the cdf given by (2) with p = p1 and X2 having the cdf given by (2) with p = p2. Then, if p1 ≤ p2, we have X1 ≤lr X2 (implying X1 ≤hr X2 and X1 ≤st X2). The equality in the likelihood ratio order is satisfied if and only if p1 = p2.
